text: Huayuan Securities' own website lists Wuhan Financial Holdings (Group) Co., Ltd. as holding 50% of the company and being its actual controller. The group's own site describes it as a wholly state-owned enterprise of Wuhan city and the city's only first-level state financial platform; Chutian Metropolis Daily reported in 2023 that Wuhan state entities together hold 72.5% of Huayuan Securities, with the group as controlling shareholder.
short: Wuhan Financial Holdings Group, wholly owned by the Wuhan city government, holds 50% of Huayuan Securities and is its actual controller.
